messages:
ava: Dropping a compact mock and a couple quick questions about the latency card on narrow viewports. Goal: keep p95 readable, make sampling easy to reach, and ensure keyboard access for heatmap cells.
rui: Nice—can you list the decisions you want help with?
ava: 1) sampling control: presets dropdown vs tiny slider; 2) heatmap keyboard grid behavior; 3) how to indicate pinned ranges in cramped cards.
jamal: My vote: presets dropdown (x1,5%,10%) plus a small "custom" that reveals a slider. Slider is great for power users but a11y needs a non-visual fallback.
lisa: Heatmap: use role="grid" and each cell role="gridcell". Announce concise labels like "bucket 2 of 8: 78 reqs, p95 184 ms". Debounce announcements until user stops scrubbing (300ms).
morgan: Ops prefers default sample=5% for heavy queries. Also request that pinning be per-user only; no global dashboard changes without save.
celeste: For pinned range UX, small filled pin icon in the top-right of each card. Tooltip: "Pinned range (per you)". When pinned, add a thin dashed outline around the card.
rui: For mobile: make pin target >=44px. Abbreviate bucket labels ("<50") but keep unit in legend header. Tooltip always full unit.
ava: Copy tweaks: legend -> "Latency (ms)", tooltip short -> "p95: 214 ms", sampling label -> "Data sample" (maps to support phrasing).
jamal: Backend note: API param remains sample_rate; client will map label->param. Also add /baselines?compare=previous_deploy for the dashed overlay.
lisa: Reduced-motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion and a user pref. If set, jump scrubbing instead of animating. Also ensure focus ring visible for scrubber.
design-bot: Ava uploaded updated Figma mock -> https://redwood.app/figma/compact-latency-pin-sampling.
ava: Thanks all. I'll push a small spec update and a11y checklist by EOD; sync tomorrow 10am.
